'''Water-skimmers''' or '''water skimmers''' were aquatic vehicles. Racing water-skimmers was an intense and dangerous activity, and was a favored pastime of [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] members on leave.<ref name="ROE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>  [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] possessed one of these at [[Victory Lake]].
